builtins.name: Allowlist
builtins.summary: Only listed keys (inline) or keys holding a fresh issuer-signed allowlist record may proceed.

config.name: key_a
config.description: inline: allowed key; record: producer program

config.name: key_b
config.description: inline: second allowed key (optional); record: required issuer

accounts: record source: the target's allowlist state record (schema 1, namespace allowlist:v1)
builtins.failure: Rejects (reason 2) when the target is not listed or no valid record is supplied.
security: Record source trusts the configured producer program and issuer.
Inline lists hold at most two keys per entry.

builtins.name: Dynamic fee
builtins.summary: Sets the pool swap fee from swap size (ramp) or from price volatility (deviation from an EMA).

config.name: pivot
config.description: size mode: amount at which max applies

config.name: alpha_bps
config.description: volatility: EMA weight of the new price

config.name: sensitivity_bps
config.description: volatility: fee bps added per 10000 bps of deviation ×10000

builtins.failure: Never rejects. The pool clamps the fee to its max_fee_ppm; the pool's program hook dynamic fee, if any, takes precedence.
security: Volatility mode reads the pre-swap pool price, which earlier swaps in the same slot can move.
Size mode can be split around by smaller swaps.

enforcement.pool: program: every operation on Pump Hooks pools

builtins.name: Price impact
builtins.summary: Rejects swaps whose constant-product impact amount/(reserve_in+amount) exceeds max_bps.
builtins.failure: Rejects (reason 14) above the limit, and when no reserves are available (fails closed).
security: Uses max_in for exact-out swaps (conservative).
Split swaps each pass individually.

enforcement.pool: program: every operation on Pump Hooks pools

builtins.name: Price limit / range
builtins.summary: Realized price (output per input) and/or post-swap pool price must lie within [min, max]. Range-order and limit execution guard.

config.name: asset
config.description: realized mode: only when the input mint is this (zero = any)

security: Router: realized amounts are measured by the router from token balances, not reported by the venue.
Pool-price mode needs reserves; routes have none.

builtins.name: Slot limit (MEV)
builtins.summary: At most N operations per slot on the subject; optionally an actor already seen this slot is refused (same-slot round trips).

config.name: flags
config.description: 1 = refuse a repeat actor in the same slot

builtins.state: slot u64, count u32, first two actors (8-byte prefixes)
security: Sees only operations on this subject; trades on other venues are invisible.
An attacker can use two signers; only the first two actors of a slot are remembered.
